post_result_rationale: R1 fresh continuation improves all spell means but reduces v1 short recall; quality50 preserves short recall but loses clean/v2 spell. Test coarse probability mixtures for complementary errors. Official decoded metrics are nonlinear; no interpolation of score values is assumed.
pooling: Arithmetic mixture of cached raw CE H/A/D probabilities before the unchanged conditional H/A expert mixture. Per-seed diagnostics use matching cached phase means.
control_replay: All three R1 arms, all35 cells, official metrics and saved prediction equality before candidate scoring
cohort: Same five exposed original-provider development matches; 5 clean,10v1,20v2 cells. Equal realizations within match, equal matches within provider, equal providers.
guards: Each view spell >= approved frontier, v2 strictly >; each view short recall >= frontier; each view macro >= frontier minus .001; exact D and reference counts.
ranking: Unrounded v2 spell descending, macro for exact ties, ID
stop_rule: Complete exactly these four candidates and independent audit; no extra weight, decoder or stage search under this ID. If none retains all guards, retain the approved frontier. No automatic promotion if one passes.
